blockers: Zone-3 gap-placement proof: given w₂ in N from cross_extend_bwd_1var with matching depth-(K+1) 1-var type and w₂ > t', need to show (or find alternative) w₂ < x' to satisfy the full 3-var NF. The argument: (1) char_fn(K+1)(nf_w) characterizes w's type as temporal formula, (2) semantic_prior_UZ on N with this formula in (t', x') finds first occurrence w' with t' < w' < x', (3) structural constraint from h_x bounds w' below x'. Step (3) requires showing that the depth-(K+2) 1-var agreement at x/x' implies no element with w's type can exceed x', which follows from the quantifier part of h_x encoding interval structure.

continuation_context.key_insight: Three approaches were analyzed and all reduce to the same sub-problem. The zone-3 proof mechanism: (1) From h_1var_w₂, w₂ has matching depth-(K+1) 1-var type as w. (2) From hw₂ (2-var agreement at [w,t]/[w₂,t']), w₂ > t'. (3) From hw₁ (2-var agreement at [w,x]/[w₁,x']), w₁ < x'. (4) w₂ and w₁ have the same 1-var type. (5) Using semantic_prior_UZ on N with char_fn characterizing this type in (t', x'), find w' in (t', x'). (6) Apply IH (nvar_transfer_from_1var_agree at depth d) to establish full 3-var agreement. Step 5 requires showing a witness EXISTS in (t', x'), which follows from w₁ < x' (step 3) and the type transfer. Step 6 requires order matching of w' relative to all env' components.
